categories.name: Client Issue
categories.description: Emails from clients reporting problems with placed staff, service quality, or expressing dissatisfaction that could lead to contract termination or financial impact.

categories.name: Action Required
categories.description: Emails requiring immediate action or decision-making from the user, often with a deadline or significant consequence if ignored.

categories.name: Client Request
categories.description: Emails from clients requesting new placements, changes to existing placements, or information about services and billing.

categories.name: Candidate Application
categories.description: Emails from individuals applying for open positions or expressing interest in working with the agency.

categories.name: Billing & Payments
categories.description: Emails related to invoices, payments sent or received, or account statements from vendors or clients.

categories.name: System Alert
categories.description: Automated notifications from software systems about account activity, security, or job posting status.

categories.name: Vendor Marketing
categories.description: Promotional emails, newsletters, or updates from software vendors or industry publications.

questions: The email from Payrollly Support is a security alert requiring action. Should this be in 'System Alert' or 'Action Required' given its high stakes?
